props.title: MXBloom Films: Denver wedding photography and video.
props.lede: A lot of couples hire a photographer and a videographer separately, and then hope the two of them work well together on the day. With MXBloom Films, it’s one team.

headingText.html: Neil and Fiona are a husband-and-wife team based in Denver and Seattle, and they personally handle both the photography and the filmmaking. Their photographs are bright and lovely, and their wedding films are emotional and cinematic.

rows.text: They offer wedding photography and cinematography, and they have combination packages if you want both.
They work throughout Colorado and Washington, and at destination weddings too.
They have nearly 10 years of experience and have captured close to 300 weddings.
They’ve received WeddingWire Couples’ Choice and The Knot Best of Weddings awards from 2020 to 2025.
You can read what couples say about them on WeddingWire and The Knot.

props.html: We book live music for weddings across Colorado, and the people on our Preferred Vendor List are the ones we’d want our own clients to call. When one team takes care of the photographs and the film, you have fewer people to coordinate, and they’re already working from the same plan.

Neil and Fiona describe their style as a mix of documentary and editorial. They work in the background for most of the day and step in with some gentle direction when it’s needed, which is a relief if you feel awkward in front of a camera. They also take just one event per day, so your wedding has their full attention.

We think about sound, too. A wedding film carries your vows and your first dance, and Neil and Fiona bring professional audio recording along with their cameras. If we’re playing your wedding and you’d like to plan the music with your film in mind, just let us know and we’ll be happy to talk with them.
This is the team to book when you want your photographs and your film from the same two people, with a natural, story-driven look.

To see if they’re free for your date, get in touch with Neil and Fiona through their website.
